empty.title: No open contradictions
empty.body: Your memories agree with each other. When two facts about the same thing disagree, they'll appear here side by side to resolve. Everything else Cogeto settles on its own.

item.heading: These two facts disagree
item.correctionExplainer: Corrections never rewrite history: each saves a new, approved version and keeps the old one as its predecessor.
item.notAConflictTitle: They don't actually conflict. Restore both as they were
